notes: DEFAULT_RULESET stays v1: per the design's rollout, v2 becomes the default only after evals and synthetic truth for the new features pass (T10). metrics.py change: M9's round-trip offset and M16's numerator now read NON_TRADING_IN (OTHER plus the five new non-trading credit categories) where they read OTHER. Under v1 this is the same set, and it is what keeps M1-M16 unchanged under v2 when v2 names a credit. T04 still owns the M16 rename/denominator and the bucket figures. Rule-table schema additions (all optional, v1 unchanged and still pinned): `names` (whole-word list) as an alternative to `pattern`, `unless`, `protected`. Firm-rule, profile and override layers exist as keyword parameters of categorise()/classify() and are covered by the precedence tests. Their production callers come in later tasks (T05 profile, T16 overrides, Tier 2 firm rules). This task's production caller is cma run via graph.categorise with CMA_RULESET=v2. CMA_RULESET=v1 avoids this, and it comes from T02's enum. Environment: the shared site-packages editable install of cma points at the T12 worktree. pytest (pythonpath=src) and evals (sys.path insert) both use this worktree's src, so the results above are for this worktree.
